data.title: Two Sum
data.problemStatement: Given an array of integers and a target, return the indices of the **two distinct elements** whose sum equals the target. Exactly one valid pair exists.
data.inputDescription: Line 1: n. Line 2: n space-separated integers. Line 3: the target.
data.outputDescription: Two indices i and j (0-based, i < j) separated by a space.
